sections.title: What Is It and Why Does It Exist?
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    FUNCTION CALLING EXPLAINED                   │
│                                                                 │
│  THE PROBLEM WITHOUT FUNCTION CALLING:                          │
│  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │
│  User: "What's the weather in Tokyo right now?"                 │
│  LLM:  "The weather in Tokyo is currently sunny                 │
│          with 24°C" ← MADE UP! LLM has no internet.            │
│                                                                 │
│  THE SOLUTION — FUNCTION CALLING:                               │
│  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │
│  User: "What's the weather in Tokyo right now?"                 │
│                │                                                │
│                ▼                                                │
│  LLM thinks:  "I need real data. I'll call the weather tool."   │
│                │                                                │
│                ▼                                                │
│  LLM outputs: {"tool": "get_weather", "args": {"city":"Tokyo"}} │
│                │                                                │
│                ▼                                                │
│  YOUR CODE:   Calls actual weather API → {"temp":24,"sky":"sun"}│
│                │                                                │
│                ▼                                                │
│  LLM reads:   The real data, formulates response                │
│                │                                                │
│                ▼                                                │
│  LLM outputs: "Tokyo is currently sunny at 24°C." ✅ ACCURATE  │
│                                                                 │
│  KEY INSIGHT: LLM decides WHEN to use a tool.                   │
│  You define WHAT tools exist.                                   │
│  Your code handles HOW tools execute.                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
